items.hook: A Stone For Danny Fisher is a serious early novel by Harold Robbins that looks at the effect of the Great Depression on a lower-middle class Jewish family.
items.body: Written in 1952, it is set in the period up to 1944. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Munthirikkaadu is a 2023 Indian Tamil-language historical crime thriller film written and directed by Kalanjiyam, and produced by him under the banner of Aathi Thiraikalam.
items.body: The film stars Seeman, Pugazh Mahendran, Subapriya and Jaya Rao. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Montana 1948 is a 1993 novella by Larry Watson.
items.body: The novella focuses on the life of young Montanan David Hayden, his family and the fictional town of Bentrock, Montana, and focuses on the struggles of a family torn between loyalty and justice. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
